mentions.description: A solo-built commercial project at smmdealfinder.com, developed over the past 18 months; the author describes it as a clear commercial project and credits the journey with developing them from a junior engineer to senior+/staff level.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m solo-coding the clear commercial project smmdealfinder.com  which is not ground-breaking or amazing as these other great projects here, but its been an amazing journey for me personally for the last 18 months and has developed me probably from a junior engineer to senior+/staff.
